RAY GRADY JACKSON JESSICA SEAT-KLATT LORNE GREENE HAYDEN ZZYT
other_text: SOUTHERN RACIST PRISONER MR. BLACK IS SENT TO A JACKSON COUNTY JAIL TO SERVE HIS SENTENCE. SPECIAL VISITOR LORNE GREENE ARRIVES TO OFFER MR. BLACK A CHANCE AT REDEMPTION. MR. BLACK'S JOURNEY THROUGH THE INHUMANE CONDITIONS OF THE JAIL WILL TEST HIS FAITH, FAMILY, AND FRIENDSHIP, AND FORCE HIM TO CONFRONT THE TRUTH ABOUT HIS PAST AND THE SYSTEM THAT TRIED TO DESTROY HIM.
description: A black-and-white poster features a silhouette of a man facing away, with the title "MR. BLACK" prominently displayed below.
